description: A request omits MCP-Protocol-Version while still carrying mirrored routing headers. An intermediary that enforces policy on those headers is now trusting values no server has validated. The spec tells intermediaries to reject rather than trust in exactly this case.

expected.signal: mirrored routing headers present without a protocol version that mandates header-body validation; reject rather than trust the headers
expected.rationale: streamable-http §Server Validation, intermediary note: intermediaries enforcing policy on mirrored headers SHOULD verify MCP-Protocol-Version indicates a version requiring header-body validation, and SHOULD reject if it is older or absent.

provenance: synthetic — derived from the intermediary note in streamable-http §Server Validation. This is the one rule in the revision addressed specifically to gateways.
